| description = These bats proc a long duration single target stun on their melee attacks ([[Sonic Scream]]). This is dangerous to groups who depend on tanks to hold aggro, since that tank will not be generating [[aggro]] while stunned. These bats are similarly hazardous to pullers, especially if they get too many and get stunlocked. MR gear and levels will help a player resist stuns.

All see invis, and some see through [[Hide]] (verified on Green 2/6/22). One bat which paths between a Sol A zone line (marked as D on [[Nagafen's Lair]] map) and nox spider's room serves as a placeholder for the [[guano harvester]].
